baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired constructions fa-li-nafsihi and fa-alayha route the two kinds of action back to the same acting self.
baseline_models.mechanism: Purposeful work enters a two-way return circuit: fitting action benefits its agent, while ugly action becomes a burden upon that agent. The denial of zulm closes off misplacing the return on another servant.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful action supplies the deed that enters the reciprocal circuit.
The self as the very identity of the person supplies the circuit's beneficiary and bearer.
Ugliness and badness supply the adverse pole whose load falls back upon the self.
Putting something in the wrong place supplies the concrete image for denying a consequence assigned to the wrong bearer.
Owned dependents supply the vulnerable class protected by the final denial.

changed_reading.before: Good and bad deeds simply receive reward or punishment.
changed_reading.after: Each intentional deed routes its benefit or burden back to its own acting self, and divine justice excludes transferring that return to another servant.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence amila salihan fa-li-nafsihi joins fitting repair directly to the self, then names the Lord as the one who does not wrong.
baseline_models.mechanism: Salih action opposes corruption and fits its proper recipient; the self includes its intention and discernment, while lordship includes gradual repair and completion. Good action can therefore be read as self-forming repair, with evil first deforming the same interior agent.

activation_trace.role: Repair opposed to corruption supplies the action's restorative quality.
Fitness for a recipient makes the repair specifically apt for the self to which it returns.
Intention, reason, and what is inward supply the interior material shaped by action.
Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship the sustaining order within which self-formation occurs.
What causes hurt or distress supplies evil's damaging effect on its own agent.

changed_reading.before: A righteous deed is an externally classified good credited to its doer.
changed_reading.after: Righteous action is fitting repair by which the agent's own interior is formed, whereas evil first damages that same self.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Amila, rabbuka, zallam, and al-abid place work, lordship, denied withholding, and dependent servants in one compact frame.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch inventory exposes a master-worker economy beneath the moral sentence: work may have wages, a lord owns and governs, servants are dependent, and zulm may withhold a right. The verse can thus deny that divine lordship extracts servants' work while confiscating its due fruit.

activation_trace.role: The wage or provision of work supplies the laborer's due return.
Ownership and governance supply the asymmetrical lord-servant relation.
Withholding and confinement from a right supply the specific exploitative act being denied.
The owned servant supplies the dependent worker whose due could otherwise be vulnerable.

changed_reading.before: The final clause only denies arbitrary divine cruelty.
changed_reading.after: The clause also admits an exploratory non-extraction reading: the Lord does not withhold the fruit due to dependent servants' work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah pairs righteous work with an uncut wage and later calls the destination prepared hospitality from a forgiving giver. This revises a closed self-causation model: li-nafsihi identifies who receives the good, not an autonomous source that manufactures every surplus of reward.

activation_trace.role: Work's wage supplies the focus-side expectation that labor has a due return.
Compensation for work makes the good return explicitly remunerative.
Non-cutting supplies the reward's uninterrupted duration rather than a merely equivalent private effect.
Prepared hospitality supplies a gift-like surplus received by the righteous actor.
Covering the fault and protecting its bearer identifies a forgiving source beyond the self.

structural_cues: 41:8 pairs righteous work with an uncut reward.
41:32 recasts the promised destination as prepared hospitality from a forgiving and merciful giver.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wage, non-interruption, hospitality, and forgiveness; I infer a distinction between beneficiary and source. A live alternative is that these are only external confirmations of an entirely causal self-return.

changed_reading.before: Good action produces a benefit wholly inside an actor-owned moral circuit.
changed_reading.after: Good action is for the actor as beneficiary, while its uncut wage and hospitable surplus still come from the forgiving Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The body that performed the work becomes present evidence: skin testifies about action, divine sight observes it, and signs appear within selves. The focus prepositions are therefore more than bookkeeping; deeds return to a self that has become their archive and exhibit.

activation_trace.role: The person's own identity supplies the bearer into which the deed's result returns.
Declaration from knowledge supplies the juridical act by which embodied evidence speaks.
The body's skin as its covering supplies the material surface that bears and voices the record.
Purposeful deeds identify exactly what the embodied witnesses disclose.
Direct seeing supplies divine observation of whatever work is chosen.
Signs located in the selves turn the same self into an evidentiary site.
Presence with observation closes the gap between deed, bearer, and divine witness.

structural_cues: 41:20-22 makes hearing, sight, and skins testify about what their owners worked.
41:40 joins unrestricted chosen work to divine sight.
41:53 places clarifying signs within the selves and ends with the Lord as witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily testimony, observed work, and signs in selves; I infer that action leaves an evidentiary trace in its performer. The alternative is a courtroom miracle with no claim about how deeds ordinarily inhabit the self.

changed_reading.before: A separate ledger later assigns each deed to its doer.
changed_reading.after: The acting self is itself the deed's embodied archive, so judgment discloses what the agent already bears rather than importing an alien charge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated righteous work is specified by repelling harm with what is better until an enemy becomes a close ally. Salih's reconciliation branch becomes active: action benefits the self not by remaining private but by repairing the relation around it and returning that transformed social field to the actor.

activation_trace.role: Reconciliation that removes estrangement supplies a latent social mechanism inside righteous action.
Purposeful action repeats the focus formula and carries it into public speech and invitation.
Reconciliation supplies the social reach of the repeated righteous work.
Doing the good supplies the superior response that operates on the hostile relation.
Pushing away harm supplies the causal operation without merely mirroring the offense.
Actual enmity supplies the damaged relation to be repaired.
Affection, aid, and alliance supply the relation produced at the far end of repair.

structural_cues: 41:33 repeats the focus formula of one who works righteous action.
41:34 explicitly moves from unequal good and evil through a better response to enemy-ally reversal.
41:35 makes patient self-restraint the condition for receiving this pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated righteous work and an enemy-to-ally reversal after repelling with better; I infer that the transformed relation is one way the good returns to the actor. The alternative is that li-nafsihi refers only to later reward, not present social feedback.

changed_reading.before: Righteous work repairs an isolated inner self.
changed_reading.after: Righteous work can repair a hostile relation, and the newly allied social world is itself part of the good that returns to the actor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding verse distinguishes delayed adjudication from abandoned adjudication: a prior word stays a decisive judgment amid entangled doubt. The focus principle explains why deferment is not injustice, since each deed continues to attach to its own self while collective decision is restrained.

activation_trace.role: Misplacement supplies the injustice excluded even while judgment is not immediate.
Each person's own identity remains the stable bearer during the delay.
Precedence supplies the prior word that holds back immediate settlement.
A decisive ruling supplies the counterfactual act postponed between the disputants.
Interpenetrating uncertainty supplies the unresolved human state in which just deferment operates.

structural_cues: 41:45 says the dispute would already have been decided but for a prior word.
41:46 immediately replaces visible settlement with individual deed-to-self reciprocity and denial of injustice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies postponed decision, continuing dispute, and the adjacent justice maxim; I infer that the maxim governs the interval of delay. The alternative is that the two verses address unrelated judicial scales.

changed_reading.before: No divine injustice means fair outcomes should already be visibly settled.
changed_reading.after: A decision may be deliberately deferred without becoming unjust, because every deed remains attached to its own bearer throughout the unresolved interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus verse, the human speaker appropriates mercy as 'mine,' turns a side away under blessing, but describes evil as something that merely touches from outside. The focus's balanced li-nafsihi and alayha grammar corrects this asymmetry by restoring the self's agency and exposure on both sides.

activation_trace.role: The same self as personal identity supplies a single bearer for both favorable and adverse returns.
What causes distress supplies the focus's adverse pole without severing it from agency.
An effect that strikes or reaches someone supplies the passive idiom used for experienced evil.
Evil and badness supply the externalized event that produces despair.
Merciful tenderness supplies the gift that the recipient immediately claims as his own possession.
Harm as loss opposed to benefit supplies the adverse state preceding that claim.
Purposeful deeds supply what will be disclosed after the speaker's self-serving attribution.
Good condition and blessing supply the favorable state followed by withdrawal.
Turning one's side away supplies the bodily posture of disowning dependence under blessing.

structural_cues: 41:49 casts desired good as repeatedly requested but evil as an outside touch.
41:50 has the beneficiary call received mercy 'mine' before being told of his works.
41:51 contrasts turning aside under blessing with expansive prayer under harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies asymmetric possessive, passive, and bodily postures; I infer that the focus verse's parallel clauses deliberately repair that attribution bias. The alternative is that the later scenes diagnose ingratitude without commenting on the focus syntax.

changed_reading.before: The verse states an abstractly balanced law of moral consequence.
changed_reading.after: Its balance also rebukes a self that claims good as inherent property while narrating evil only as an alien touch.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers an ecological revival image into moral psychology and activates breath/growth branches rather than the ordinary referent of nafs. It remains anchored in li-nafsihi, the Lord's nurturing branch, the revived earth, and signs within selves. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy, not a lexical replacement for 'self.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The good is explicitly for the nafs under a rabb, allowing breath, opening, nurture, and revived growth to model what righteous action does to its bearer.

activation_trace.role: Breath emerging from within supplies an exploratory image of the self becoming live and open.
Dawn-like opening and spreading supplies the changed inner condition produced by repair.
Nurture, repair, and completion supply the cultivative agency under which the self changes.
Nourishment and growth supply the earth's movement from barrenness toward developed life.
Earth revived by rain supplies the ecological analogue for a repaired self.
Signs in the selves keep the ecological transfer tethered to actual personal identities.

changed_reading.before: Righteous work deposits a favorable item in the self's account.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, righteous work lets the inner ground breathe, open, and grow under nurturing lordship, while evil works against that liveliness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the immediate botanical and reproductive sequence as a model of moral consequence rather than as a separate knowledge catalogue. It remains validly anchored in work returning to the self and in the next verse's hidden fruit, inner carrying, emergence, and delivery under divine knowledge. Downstream prose should present it as a sequence-driven analogy, not claim that the focus words literally mean pregnancy or fruit.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus routes each deed to or upon its own self; the next verse pictures outcomes held inside bearers and then brought out.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful work supplies the initiating deed whose consequence develops.
The self as the person's own identity supplies the bearer in which the consequence is carried.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the emergence of a previously hidden result.
Fruit as realized benefit supplies the mature favorable outcome.
The plant's enclosing sheath supplies the hidden chamber in which fruit develops.
Inner carrying and fruit-bearing supply the interval during which an outcome remains internal.
Delivering a carried load supplies the eventual manifestation of what the bearer contained.

changed_reading.before: Moral consequence is assigned to the self in a single judicial step.
changed_reading.after: The adjacent sequence permits a gestational model: deeds develop within their bearer and emerge as their own mature benefit or burden under complete knowledge.

strongest_changes: The self became both bearer and embodied evidence of its work, not merely the name on an external ledger.
Righteous action became relational repair whose enemy-to-ally transformation returns a changed social field to the actor.
For the self came to name the beneficiary without making the self the autonomous source of uncut reward and forgiving hospitality.
The focus symmetry became a correction of the later human tendency to own mercy while externalizing evil.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly materialized moral reciprocity: in wages, bodily witnesses, repaired relations, delayed judgment, revived ground, and hidden fruit or pregnancy brought into the open. These mechanisms preserve the focus anchor while preventing 'for himself/against it' from collapsing into a single abstract ledger.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the labor-master economy is rhetorically active or only a branch-level lexical resonance.
Whether the ecological and gestational models should enter commentary or remain contained exploratory analogies.
Whether deed-to-self return is primarily causal formation, judicial allocation, or deliberately both.
